messages:
Jamie L: Quick handover — I'm handing off the overnight deploy for feature/kv-cache-invalidate. Deploy window: 2026-03-20 02:00 UTC (2h window for safety). No DB migrations, only service + cache invalidation job. CI: https://ci.redwood/boards/4321 :rocket:
Alex P: Thanks Jamie — I'm on for watchers. Which services are in the rollout? any traffic-shift plan?
Jamie L: rollout order: api-gateway -> inference-runtime -> cache-worker. Canary at 5% for 20m, then 25% for 15m, then full. Traffic-shift handled by our rollout controller with automatic rollback on 5xx spike.
Priya R: Heads up — the cache invalidation touches the prefix namespace used by embeddings cache. Risk: small window of stale reads for ~30s while jobs run. We should ensure the prefilling job is in the smoke checklist.
Tobias S: Noted. Rollback plan: cut traffic to previous revision and run `kubectl rollout undo deployment/inference-runtime -n prod` AND re-run cache warmers. I'll be ready to trigger.
Alex P: Can someone add the exact canary command to the runbook? I'll be doing the watch. Also tagging @oncall to be sure.
Jamie L: Added the snippet to runbook. Canary deploy command (for reference):
```
redwood deploy --service inference-runtime --image gcr.io/redwood/inference:kv-cache-20260320 --canary 5 --canary-duration 20m
```
Jamie L: Smoke checks (manual + automated): 1) health endpoints ok, 2) 10 sample generation requests (check latency < 200ms), 3) verify embeddings cache miss rate decreases within 5m, 4) alert if 5xx rate > 0.5% during canary.
deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy created by Jamie L for 2026-03-20T02:00:00Z. Reminder set 30m before. Runbook: https://intra/redwood/runbooks/kv-cache-deploy
Alex P: I'll start watchers at T-15 and post a status every 10m in this thread. @Tobias S will be primary rollback contact. Priya, can you own the smoke verification?
Priya R: Yep — I'll run the sample requests and post results. If embeddings miss-rate doesn't improve within 10m, I'll signal rollback.
Tobias S: I'll be reachable on pager and phone. If rollback needed, I'll do it and notify infra.
Alex P: Quick ask — there is a small PR (#9876) with a perf tweak. Need a +1 from eng-runtime before midnight so it can be included. Jamie, can you ping the reviewer?
Jamie L: Pinged @eng-runtime in PR comments. Also left a note in the deploy checklist about PRs needing green CI and reviewer approval.
Alex P: Great. Everyone — FYI there's a deploy freeze between 00:00-01:30 UTC earlier than our window; our plan respects that. I'll escalate if anything outside expected happens. :thumbsup:
Priya R: Thanks. I'll post the smoke run output here once canary starts.
Jamie L: Thanks all — handing off. Good luck and ping if anything unexpected shows up.
